simple.meaning: to draw , used in a great variety of applications (including to sow , to sound , to prolong , to develop , to march , to remove , to delay , to be tall , etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָשַׁךְ (H4900) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.full: H4900. mashak מָשַׁךְ verb draw, drag (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic מְשַׁח (rare) be extended , also conduct, take , Syriac is be dry, shrivelled (of fruit., etc.); Ethiopic bend (the bow); Arabic grasp and hold I. Frey; IV. Frey Lane; compare also Assyrian mašku , skin (perhaps also march Dl HWB 431 ), Arabic id. , Aramaic , מַשְׁכָּא id. ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳מ 1Kin 22:34 2 t., וּמָשַׁךְ consecutive Job 24:22 ; 3 feminine singular מָֽשְׁכָה Deut 21:3 , etc.; Imperfect יִמְשׁוֺךְ Job 21:33 ; וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ Judg 20:37 ; 2 masculine singular suffix תִּמְשְׁכֵנִי Psa 28:3 ; 1 singular suffix אֶמְשְׁכֵם Hosea 11:4 , etc.; Imperative מְשֹׁךְ Psa 36:11 , suffix מָשְׁכֵנִי Song 1:4 ; masculine plural מִשְׁכוּ Exod 12:21 , מָשְׁכוּ Ezek 32:20 ; Infinitive construct מְשֹׁךְ Exod 19:13 ; Josh 6:5 , לִמְשׁוֺךְ Eccl 2:3 ; Participle משֵׁךְ Amos 9:13 ; Psa 109:12 ; plural משְׁכִים Judg 5:14 ; construct משְׁכֵי Isa 5:18 ; 66:19 ; — 1 draw and lift out of ( מִן ), with accusative of person, הַבּוֺר מִן אֶתיֿוֺסֵף וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ Gen 37:28 (E), so Jeremiah (+ ב בַּחֲבָלִים, instrumental) Jer 38:13 ; compare בְּחַכָּה לִוְיָתָן תִּמְשֹׁךְ Job 40:25; draw, drag along הֵשָּׁוְא בְּחַבְלֵי עָוֺן משְׁכֵי Isa 5:18 (figurative); בְּרִשְׁתּוֺ בְּמָשְׁכוֺ Psa 10:9 (figurative of wicked catching and dragging the poor); draw, lead along (with hostile purpose) with accusative of person Judg 4:7 (subject ׳י ; + אֶלֿ person and thing); lead or drag off (to doom, subject ׳י ) Psa 28:3 (compare 26:9 ); similarly, or = draw down to death, וגו אוֺתָהּ ׳מָשְׁכוּ Ezek 32:20 (si vera lectio; reference to fall of Egypt), but read perhaps a form of שׁכב for ᵐ5 משׁכו, Co Berthol, compare Sm.; absolute, subject heifer, בְּעוֺל מָֽשְׁכָה Deut 21:3 ( ב instrumental); draw, lead (in love), (figurative, subject ׳י ) אֶמְשְׁכֵם אָדָם בְּחַבְלֵי Hosea 11:4 , compare Jer 31:3 (al. as 5 below ) 2 draw the bow, ׳מ בַּקֶּשֶׁת 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 , but ק ׳משְׁכֵי Isa 66:19 (where text dubious, ᵐ5 Μοσοχ καὶ εἰς ( θΩβελ ), so Lo Sta Javan 8 Du Che Hpt , — not Gr Che Comm Di). 3 proceed, march (compare German ziehen ) תָּבוֺר בְּהַר וּמָשַׁכְתָָּ֫ Judg 4:6 ; compare 20:37 (absolute), Job 21:33 ( אַחֲרָיו ); so also (perhaps) Exod 12:21 proceed (i.e. forthwith), and take you a sheep; and probably בְּשֵׁבֶט משְׁכִים Judg 5:14 those marching with the staff , etc. (most under 2 drawing with , i.e. wielding). 4 draw out a sound, give a sound , הַיֹּבֵל בִּמְשֹׁךְ Exod 19:13 (E) when the ram ('s horn) sounds , בִּמ ׳הַיֹּבֵל בְּקֶרֶן Josh 6:5 (JE). 5 draw out, prolong, continue , לְֹידְעֶיךָ חַסְדְּךָ מְשֹׁח Psa 36:10 prolong, continue thy kindness to them that know thee ; חֶסֶד משֵׁךְ לוֺ אַליְֿהִי 109:12 ; (so possibly חָ֑סֶד מְשַׁכְתִּיךָ Jer 31:3 I have prolonged kindness to thee , compare Ryle Neh 9:30 ; and elsewhere as 1 above ); compare רַבּוֺת ׳וַתִּמ שָׁנִים עֲלֶיהֶם Neh 9:30 ( חֶסֶד omitted); ׳תִּמ וָדֹר לְדֹר אַמְּךָ Neh 85:6 (|| בָּנוּ תֶּאֱנַף הַלְעוֺלָם ); ׳וּמ בְּכֹחוֺ אַבִּירִים Job 24:22 i.e. he (God) prolongeth the life of the mighty (Du draggeth them off , as Psa 28:3 1 above , — reading also אֹבְּדִים for ׳אַבּ with ᵐ5 Bi); compare Niph`al 6. trail seed (draw along in sowing) Amos 9:13 (opposed to עֲנָבִים דָֹּרֵךְ ; compare מֶשֶׁךְ below) 7 (late) cheer (draw, attract, gratify) אֶתבְּֿשָׂרִי ׳מ בַּיַּיִן Eccl 2:3 , — so De (who cites Late Hebrew, Chag 14a ) Now Wild. — אֶתלֹּֿצֲצִים יָדוֺ מָשַׁךְ Hosea 7:5 is difficult, ᵐ5 AV RV he stretcheth out his hand with , maketh common cause with, is hardly possibly, text probably corrupt We Now. Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine plural יִמָּשֵׁ֑כוּ לֹא Isa 13:22 they shall not be prolonged (days of Babylon); 3 feminine singular תִּמָּשֵׁךְ לֹא Ezek 12:25 , 28 it shall not be postponed .
